note: Image generation prompts and reference ordering. Images are design explorations, not functional screens.

logo.prompt: Use case logo-brand. Generate one initial standalone logo symbol for ClearFi, a calm premium personal-finance product. This is an exploratory concept pending further user logo references. Transparent background, square 1024x1024, centered symbol with generous clear space, no board, no text, no watermark, no mockup scene. The symbol should be original and simple: two elegantly offset rounded bands that together suggest an open C, a clear aperture and controlled flow. Continuous precise curves, flat vector-like finish, no 3D extrusion, no glass effects, no shadow. Must remain recognizable at favicon scale. One solid dark azure #00638E color only, fully opaque symbol with transparent negative space. Use the attached palette as color authority and the soft material moodboard for curvature only. Avoid dollar signs, shields, locks, checkmarks, generic AI sparkle, Apple logo, mastercard circles or existing payment logos. Refined, effortless, suitable for web and mobile app icon.

web.prompt:
Create realistic, production-quality UI with clear hierarchy, strong typography, intentional imagery and purposeful spacing. This is ClearFi, a personal finance web application, not a marketing site. One desktop screen at 1440 x 1024 target composition. App content only, no browser chrome/device, no multiple concept collage. User wants clean, simple, Apple-like, fluid, exquisitely articulated. Interpret all supplied references as material/composition inspiration, never copy their brand names or unrelated crypto features. The palette image is authoritative: dark azure #00638E; paper white #FFFFFF; black #000000; onyx surface #141414; charcoal #2B2B2B; light azure #BFD8E3. Brand gradient only #000000 → #004A6B → #00638E → #8CB9CC. Do NOT use the references' green/lime, purple, orange or gold as brand colors. Warm amber may be a tiny semantic hold accent only. Use soft continuous corners, frosted functional chrome, quiet hairline highlights, tactile layered depth, generous whitespace, system-like typography, 14-16px body, tabular numerals and little uppercase text. Glass only where it creates hierarchy, content on legible solid or near-solid surfaces. No cards inside cards, no feature inventory, no decorative chart or fabricated growth percentage. A tentative simple original logo of two offset rounded bands forming an open C with a clear gap, next to ClearFi wordmark; no Apple logo, currency symbol, lock or shield. Date anchor Saturday October 10, 2026. Preserve four product destinations Overview, Transfers, Assistant, Controls (labels for existing routes). Header clear compact 'Demo · simulated money'. User Alice Chen. Demo account fixtures: Everyday Checking ••4410 $4,250.00, High-Yield Savings ••7702 $12,800.00, Individual Brokerage ••3091 $8,420.15 view-only demo import. Total $25,470.15. AI explains and proposes; humans approve exact actions. Transfer scenario $1,850.00 to Oak Street Properties, held because verified Summit Community Bank ••4821 changed to Harborview Credit Union ••9930. Simulation labels remain clear. StreamFlix increase $15.49 → $22.99, up $7.50; latest Oct 8, 2026. No autonomous approval, no live banking, no fake credit card numbers or credit-card issuance, no trading controls, no cancel endpoint. Focus on one hero use case and at most two supporting regions. Meaningful primary action, realistic legible labels, no cropped content. Output one independent image.
Direction: Obsidian Flow. A premium dark overview that feels like a beautifully designed native Mac finance app translated to the web. Strong asymmetrical editorial composition, not generic SaaS tile grid. Black #000 background, onyx #141414 sections. Left narrow floating translucent navigation rail about 200px wide, ClearFi wordmark and the logo reference, four labeled destinations. Top main greeting 'Good afternoon, Alice.' with small date Oct 10, 2026; header compact Demo label. Main hero takes around two-thirds width: a large smoothly rounded 30px balance surface with a softly refracted azure gradient only along its upper left/back surface; large white '$25,470.15' set with light elegant weight, label 'Across your demo accounts'. One clean pill-shaped white-on-dark primary button 'New transfer' and text 'Ask ClearFi'. Right support region on same page a slim near-solid onyx 'Your accounts' list with three accurate accounts/amounts, no nested cards or repeat balances inside the hero. Beneath hero and account list, one full-width warm-neutral hold row with tiny amber dot, '$1,850 rent transfer needs review' and 'Oak Street Properties changed its bank details.' primary action 'Review transfer'. Bottom section split into two open editorial regions separated by spacing: 'One thing changed' StreamFlix $15.49 → $22.99 with 'Up $7.50 this month' and evidence link; compact 'Recent activity' rows Oct 9 Bean There −$5.75, Oct 8 StreamFlix −$22.99, Oct 7 FreshMart −$84.12. Keep display uncluttered, plenty of quiet black space, smooth 24-30px corners on large surfaces, 14px on smaller controls. Glass is visible at nav and top edge of balance surface; all critical data remains high contrast. No chart. User's dark dashboard/glass-wallet references should visibly inform luxurious material depth, but use azure rather than green or gold. Make it far more art-directed and physically polished than a default Tailwind/shadcn dashboard. One app screen only.
